instruction: WolfeyVGC has a mainstay pick for his championship teams despite it being one of his most hated Pokémon. How would that Pokémon stack up to Pachirisu, listing and comparing all of their base stats from when both Pokémon each respectively first appeared on a 1st place Pokémon Videogame World Championships team?

task_metadata.problem: WolfeyVGC has a mainstay pick for his championship teams despite it being one of his most hated Pokémon. How would that Pokémon stack up to Pachirisu, listing and comparing all of their base stats from when both Pokémon each respectively first appeared on a 1st place Pokémon Videogame World Championships team?
task_metadata.answer: Incineror (2018): HP 95 (Win), Attack 115 (Win), Defense 90 (Win), Sp. Atk 80 (Win), Sp. Def 90 (Tie), Speed 60 (Lose), Total 530 (Win); Pachirisu (2014) HP 60 (Lose), Attack 45 (Lose), Defense 70 (Lose), Sp. Atk 45 (Lose), Sp. Def 90 (Tie), Speed 95 (Win), Total 405 (Lose)
